description.narrative: The JCC is targeting the creation of 14 million jobs in Ethiopia by 2025 and 20 million by 2030. Jobs in the digital economy are expected to rise by 62% by 2030, with the creation of 2 million indirect jobs by 2030.

1. Digital Entrepreneurship Team (DET) Analyst, DET Project Supervisor, and Enkopa Lead have been recruited for EDGET embedded within the Ministry of Labor and Skills. The team took the lead on the implementation of EDGET ensuring major project outputs are met and EDGET secures the highest level of visibility and support within the digital economy ecosystem. 2. In June 2022, the MoLS launched a campaign in search of groundbreaking early-stage high-growth potential entrepreneurs for a three-month dynamic incubation program. Following the online campaign, 345 applications were received through the application platform (Enkopa website). After a rigorous and multi-stage selection process from among 345 top-tier applicants from all over the country, 22 early-stage high-growth entrepreneurs were selected and enrolled at xHub Addis for an intensive incubation program. 3. The 12 startups received 5000 USD in seed funding to accelerate their growth. 4. Entrepreneurship Communications Enkopa website (http://www.enkopa.org/) developed for raising awareness on DE and sharing information on DE programs, policies, etc. had been active for the past year. Enkopa Panel sessions recorded videos, 10+ articles on several themes (Startup Act, FROG, etc.), and interviews from various media outlets have been posted on the Enkopa website. Enkopa.org remains a living platform to rally up support for promoting digital entrepreneurship in Ethiopia. 5. The 2nd National Job Summit took place at the Sheraton Addis on August 15 and 16. A half-day was dedicated to the Enkopa Summit with B2B interactions, two-panel sessions, and pitches by entrepreneurs. 6. The DET team in collaboration with Genesis Analytics, (a South Africa-based advisory firm) organized Ethiopian Delegation Learning Expedition on BPO to South Africa (November 13-19, 2022). The DET team secured additional partnerships (SNV and IFC) to fully cover the cost of travel. Unfortunately, the expedition was canceled by MoLS leadership due to unavoidable circumstances. 7. Through the Yegara portal (a portal with a mission to provide ecosystem-focused, and innovative financing service) the volume of deal flow by investors towards matched investment with startups has grown to 14,364,000 ETB (Capital Raised). Notably, some of the EDGET-supported Gig Platform Service Providers are raised money through the portal.
